agent.name: Emerging Technology Diffusion Agent
agent.specialty: Rogers diffusion, peer position and timing evidence

analytical_question: What has diffused at the general, exact-application and peer levels, and what information timing follows?
general_et_finding: ChatGPT has broad observed individual reach, but the Rogers categories innovators, early adopters, early majority, late majority and laggards cannot be assigned to all firms from consumer counts. Population, geography and product usage differ.
application_finding: Exact application and comparable professional-services peer stage: indeterminate. Rogers factors: relative advantage—possible draft speed, local quality-adjusted benefit unknown (inference); compatibility—approved inputs and human review are decisive (inference); complexity—verification and data handling add work (inference); trialability—bounded approved test is a proposed design, not observed diffusion; observability—accepted drafts, errors, rework and time could be measured, not yet observed. No standard, opinion leader or change agent was shown to cause peer spread.
organization_specific_finding: Conservative follower; unresolved confidentiality approval and limited reviewers: First resolve data authority and review capacity; use only synthetic examples for preparation until permission is granted. This is a context-specific timing interpretation, not a changed external prevalence estimate.

evidence.claim: 44% of US adults reported ever using ChatGPT in February 2026
evidence.notes: Ever-use, not regular workplace use or comparable firm deployment; 38% of employed adults reported work use of AI chatbots broadly.

evidence.claim: OpenAI reported more than one billion weekly users and 2.5 million businesses across products
evidence.notes: Global product reach and business count, not a firm-level application adoption denominator.

evidence.claim: OpenAI reported more than seven million ChatGPT for Work seats
evidence.notes: Seats are not active users; more than one million paying business customers also included API use.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Consumer ever-use and vendor customer/seat counts do not establish sustained human-reviewed drafting at comparable firms.
No organization-specific baseline, industry cohort or internal controls were supplied.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate for broad direction of spread; low for exact workflow, peer stage, causal Rogers factors and local value.
value_opportunity_implication: Measure quality-adjusted draft effort and accepted work before inferring benefit.
risk_governance_implication: Maintain human review and approved data handling; assess error and disclosure exposure.
recommendation_management_implication: Diffusion timing only: First resolve data authority and review capacity; use only synthetic examples for preparation until permission is granted. Adoption Agent retains the final decision.
change_monitoring_triggers: Representative comparable-firm evidence of sustained use for the exact task
Local baseline, review-adjusted quality, time and incident measures
Approved data controls or changed policy
abstention_or_more_information_needed: No numerical peer adoption rate or application Rogers category without a representative denominator
No final adoption approval or ROI claim
